commitments.detail: Ensure HVAC balancing between cells 4 and 5 during the production run.
Schedule 1000 units of connector-housing production across cells 4 and 5.
Deploy 2 LEL monitors and perform solvent purge for 30 minutes at the start of the run.
Production will be conducted on Cell 4.
No additional HVAC balancing hours will be allocated.
No additional HVAC balancing required due to shared system
